verdict.rationale: Resend exposes broad API coverage across its core surfaces, each documented first-party: sending and batch email, domain add/verify (explicitly offered via dashboard, API, CLI or MCP), webhooks, suppressions, API keys, broadcasts, segments, received emails and broadcast duplication. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec, an official CLI and an MCP server, and its changelog repeatedly ships features to the API/CLI/MCP alongside the dashboard. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that account-level features (SSO/team management, billing add-ons, the dashboard Vercel integration, activity visualization) are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
